build: lean athletic, slightly worn — the kind that was once obsessively maintained and still holds its shape but without vanity
skin_register: natural pores, mild fatigue lines under eyes, faint forehead creasing, not retouched — lived-in rather than weathered
hair: short to medium, dark brown with early grey at temples, low-maintenance cut, slightly unstyled — functional not groomed
wardrobe: fitted dark slate merino crewneck, no logos, slight stretch fabric — technical-casual, the kind that photographs as effortlessly considered
accessories: Whoop or Garmin tracker on left wrist, no rings, no other jewelry — gear not style
expression: eyes engaged and slightly narrowed, mouth at rest with one corner fractionally tighter — the look of someone mid-evaluation, not convinced yet but genuinely listening
body_language: shoulders settled and square, chin level, no performance lean-in — still and contained, the stillness of someone who has stopped chasing and is now waiting to be shown something real
register: skeptical intellectual — the peer who has done the reading, run the experiments, and arrived at a quiet impasse; not hostile, not hopeful, just precise
